promotion_rule: Cartography changes may be first-class governance updates; scientific claims still require evidence.
purpose: Hostile-engineer the cartography itself so the map cannot become a persuasive but false geometry.

threats.hostile_test: Split-axis sensitivity: re-encode candidate axis into finer values and test whether prior cell distinctions remain invariant.
threats.risk: Two causally distinct mechanisms are represented as one axis value.

threats.hostile_test: Dependency audit and intervention equivalence test under matched compiled exposures.
threats.risk: Two axes encode the same latent intervention.

threats.hostile_test: Require learner-payload leakage audit and label-free transfer condition.
threats.risk: Map coordinates are treated as learner-native structure.

threats.hostile_test: Evidence-density tags; prohibit manifold/interpolation claims where local neighbor support is absent.
threats.risk: Whole-shape claims inferred from too few occupied cells.

threats.hostile_test: Scientific occupancy requires admitted result identity only.
threats.risk: Runtime failures are mistaken for scientific negative cells.

threats.hostile_test: Store vector phenotype: balanced/false/true/transfer/composition/currentness; no scalar-only occupancy.
threats.risk: One summary metric hides opposing phenotype movement.

threats.hostile_test: Experiment-to-cell binding must enumerate all moved axes; >1 move classified interaction.
threats.risk: A multi-axis change is interpreted as a main effect.

threats.hostile_test: Field verifier fingerprints required; cell occupancy stores compiled-geometry signature.
threats.risk: Same high-level cell has multiple compiled realizations with different learner-visible geometry.

threats.hostile_test: Every cell keyed by regime scope; cross-regime promotion requires replication.
threats.risk: Axis effect changes with learner/model/dose regime.

threats.hostile_test: Add predecessor/history metadata and later test path-order reversals.
threats.risk: Same nominal cell reached through different developmental histories yields different phenotype.

threats.failure: Map appears noisy when latent dimension exists.
threats.hostile_test: Residual sign-flip audit; recurrent unexplained heterogeneity triggers candidate-axis proposal.
threats.risk: Observed sign flips arise from an unmodeled variable.

threats.hostile_test: No interpolation without measured local derivatives; adjacency is experimental convenience, not continuity proof.
Rank by expected ambiguity reduction and boundary value, not expected score gain.
threats.risk: Ranking favors cells likely to win rather than cells likely to discriminate.

threats.hostile_test: Unmeasured cell status remains UNKNOWN, never NEGATIVE.
threats.risk: Unmeasured holes are spoken of as real absent mechanisms.

threats.failure: Next experiment chosen from obsolete shape.
threats.hostile_test: Scientific frontier change invalidates map freshness until reconciled.
